text:
maya-billing: Heads up — AcmeHealth invoice INV-2026-042 failed to collect: card declined (processor code: 402-EXPIRED_CARD). Our retry schedule ran twice and then stopped. Putting the account on hold for now.

payments-bot: [PAYMENTS] charge_failed: customer_id=acmehealth, invoice=INV-2026-042, amount=USD 18,420.00, reason=card_expired. attempts=2

arjun-sales: Thanks Maya. I just pinged their billing contact (katie@acmehealth). She said they'll prefer ACH/wire. Can we send wire details + exact invoice breakdown so they can initiate immediately?

sophie-support: They also uploaded an updated PO and an ACH setup request form in the support ticket: https://redwood.support/tickets/8382 — compliance flagged they need RBC routing verification on our side for ACH.

maya-billing: Copy. I'll prepare a wire packet. Need clarification on whether we accept ACH for this customer (they're enterprise). Liam, any blocks from finance/compliance on ACH for AcmeHealth?

liam-finance: No block from my side. As long as we get the signed ACH form + bank name and account type. For now, wire is fastest to clear (we can reconcile after).

maya-billing: Ok sending wire instructions now. Please confirm once they start the transfer. Also note final amount includes usage overage of $3,420 tied to March inference throughput spike.

maya-billing: ```Wire instructions for Redwood Inference (USD):
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Western First Bank
SWIFT: WFBIUS6S
Account: 40123456789
Routing (ABA): 026009593
Reference: INV-2026-042 / AcmeHealth
Note: include invoice number to speed reconciliation.```

arjun-sales: Forwarded to Katie with the PO and that exact wire text. She said treasury will initiate today and send a remittance email with the transfer reference.

sophie-support: I added a note to the support ticket with the wire instructions and requested the remittance confirmation file. Also set the ticket to high priority.

maya-billing: Temporary credit hold set. Once we receive remittance and funds clear, we'll lift the hold and post payment. If they want to do ACH instead, we'll need the signed ACH form + bank micro-deposit verification (2 business days).

payments-bot: [ACTION] created billing-task #B-1127 for reconciliation and hold tracking (assignee: maya-billing).

arjun-sales: Katie replied — treasury expects to wire today EOD PST. She gave a proto-reference: RH-ACME-7432. I told them to include INV-2026-042 in the payment reference too.

liam-finance: FYI, when wire hits, ping me and I'll reconcile the overage to the usage report and adjust next invoice if needed. Also double-check tax treatment on this invoice — state nexus for AcmeHealth is CA.

maya-billing: Will do. I'll keep the thread updated. Adding a final checklist for payments team: [1] confirm remittance, [2] confirm bank trace if no clearing in 48h, [3] lift hold and notify product team.

arjun-sales: Thanks — I'll follow up with Katie for remittance and post here. :thumbsup:

sophie-support: Update: Katie uploaded a screenshot showing wire initiated with reference RH-ACME-7432 at 1761504800. Ticket updated.

maya-billing: Received their remittance email and bank trace number via DM. Marking pending deposit.

payments-bot: [BANK NOTICE] incoming_wire_pending: amount=USD 18,420.00, ref=RH-ACME-7432, received_at=1761505000

maya-billing: Deposit cleared at 1761505100. Applied payment to INV-2026-042 and removed credit hold. Posting receipt to customer and closing support ticket.

arjun-sales: Great — Katie confirmed on the call. They appreciated the quick turnaround.

liam-finance: Reconciled the overage and will include a line-item credit on next month's statement for any disputed usage after product review. Thanks team.

maya-billing: Closing thread. If anyone needs the finalized remittance file, I uploaded it to the billing drive: drive.redwood/company/billing/acmehealth/INV-2026-042/remittance.pdf
